Name: Query Vertex AI RAG
Author: cbf81976-f755-4f3f-83fd-a1b7e124ac7f
Description: Queries a Vertex AI RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Corpus to retrieve context-rich semantic search results. The action resolves the target RAG corpus ID, executes a vector search with user-configured limits (Top K), and extracts relevant historical cases, runbooks, or policy documentation. Structured findings are loaded directly into programmatic JSON outputs for downstream playbook logic and displayed on the Case Wall.

Parameters.Description: The semantic search text or question to query against the RAG knowledge base.
The maximum number of relevant context snippets to retrieve (default: 5).
